relationshipTypes.MARKETS_PROGRAM_UNDER_BRAND: Brand marketed by issuer; local site may be independently operated or managed
relationshipTypes.CONTROLLING_SHAREHOLDER_REPORTED: Company-reported controlling shareholder as of the disclosure date
relationshipTypes.EQUITY_INVESTOR: Investor; controlling vote and current ownership not assumed
relationshipTypes.REPORTED_OPERATING_BRAND: Brand listed in a dated company release
relationshipTypes.OPERATES_BUSINESS: Parent operates the named division, subsidiary or business
relationshipTypes.ACQUIRED_BUSINESS_CONTAINING_BRAND: Transaction covered brand at the announcement date
relationshipTypes.LISTED_PORTFOLIO_COMPANY: Listed as a firm portfolio company, not proof of current majority control
relationshipTypes.FOUNDED_AND_LEADS: Documented firm leadership, NOT ownership of all portfolio companies
relationshipTypes.REPORTS_BRAND_IN_PORTFOLIO: Brand explicitly listed in a company-controlled primary source; does not guarantee this parent owns every manufacturing, distribution or trademark license in each geography.

evidenceRule: Links represent named organizations, brands, investments and dated source-backed relationships. A PE portfolio relationship is NOT identical to majority ownership; a business unit is NOT necessarily a separate legal entity. Do not join ZIP to specific local facility without validated outlet registry and geo boundaries.
pricingRule: No verified local price increase or politician-to-owner-to-household causal relation is established by the graph. Also include outcomes where ownership may increase supply, efficiency, affordability or quality, if evidenced.
coverageNotes: Older Learning Care brand roster from 2018 cannot be represented as definitely current in 2026.
Kindercare investor stake is beneficial stock ownership, not a full ownership of every childcare site.
OpenLedger CERI has PG/PEP and selected brands as placeholders; they do not create ownership edges.
National employer concentration, brand groups, and political committees cannot be equated with local market concentration.
Local outlet-to-operator legal entity mapping is missing across every daily-life issue.
Eight PAC/contract recipient identities and two business investigations indexed separately without presumed parent/affiliate ownership edges.
Founder, executive, minority shareholder and ultimate controller are not interchangeable.
P&G and PepsiCo brand placeholders in OpenLedger were not automatically trusted; 24 independently verified company-roster names now have dated owner-brand links.
